ideas.title: The Impact of Child Care Fraud on Minnesota's Budget
ideas.description: Investigate the financial impact of child care fraud on Minnesota's budget and the potential solutions to address the issue.
questions: What is the estimated cost of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent similar fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: The story would require analyzing financial data and public records to understand the scope of the issue and potential solutions.

ideas.title: Examining the Pretti Shooting and Police Accountability
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the Alex Pretti shooting and the implications for police accountability.
questions: What were the events leading up to the shooting?
How does this incident reflect broader issues with police accountability?
ideas.insight: The story would require examining public records and potentially interviewing whistleblowers to understand the context of the shooting.
